content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Erika Bolton (E002), contractor, Analyst role.
Request: admin access to Payroll.

Policy:
- Contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.
- Security training: basic (not advanced).
- So maximum is read.

Requested admin is above maximum (read), so grant maximum = read.

Also, role is Analyst, not Payroll Specialist, so even full-time wouldn't get admin via ownership. But contractor never admin anyway.

Decision: read.
